method: distinct SV passages having at least one REUSES_TEXT_FROM edge to RV
scope_note: Reuse is established on comparison surfaces down to SANDHI_INSENSITIVE, the weakest level, which is the only level a Devanagari SV text and a Latin RV text can be compared on at all. The share would fall under a stricter level.

method: MENTIONS_ENTITY edges whose every matched alias is also a Devata label form, so the mention cannot be assigned to the entity rather than to the deity of the same name
scope_note: An upper bound on the deity/concept conflation, not a count of errors: some of these passages do mean the impersonal referent.

method: mantras with at least one MENTIONS_ENTITY edge to a DomainEntity
scope_note: Sanskrit evidence only. Lower than the V1 concept layer's coverage because that layer also admitted English-translation matches.
